mentions.name: Anonymous QR contact pager
mentions.description: A web app that generates printable QR codes to stick on a shop door or car windshield. When a stranger scans the code, the owner receives a notification via Telegram or email, acting like a pager while keeping personal contact details hidden.
mentions.problem: Strangers may need to reach you (e.g., about your shop or parked car) but you don't want to expose your personal contact details.
mentions.audience: People who want to be reachable by strangers (e.g., shop owners, car owners) without exposing personal contact details
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm making a web app that let's you create a QR code that you print and stick on your shop door or car windshield. When a stranger scans it, you'd get a notification on your telegram account or email without exposing your details. Kinda like a pager.
